name: io.github.xo0ps/vaultzero-mcp
title: VaultZero
description: Encrypted long-term memory for AI agents: embedded and encrypted on the client.

environmentVariables.name: VZ_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Bare HTTPS origin of the VaultZero API, for example https://api.vaultzero.cc. No path, no trailing slash.

environmentVariables.name: VZ_CREDENTIAL
environmentVariables.description: Your VaultZero bearer credential (a 64-hex-character secret). This process holds the key material, so treat it as a secret. Request access at access@vaultzero.cc.

environmentVariables.name: VZ_KEY_STORE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a persistent key store, for example ~/.vaultzero/keys.json. Strongly recommended: without it keys live in memory and every memory becomes unreadable when this process exits.

environmentVariables.name: VZ_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint, ideally customer-controlled. Without it a deterministic hashing provider is used, which is for local development only and gives no meaningful retrieval.

environmentVariables.name: VZ_EMBEDDING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for VZ_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL, if that endpoint requires one.

environmentVariables.name: VZ_EMBEDDING_SPACE
environmentVariables.description: Embedding space identifier. Pinned with VZ_EMBEDDING_MODEL, VZ_EMBEDDING_REVISION and VZ_EMBEDDING_PREPROCESSING; changing any of them changes the vectors and makes existing memories unsearchable.

environmentVariables.name: VZ_PERMITTED_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated scopes this process may read and write. Defaults to preferences,work,financial,medical.

environmentVariables.name: VZ_RETENTION_CHOICES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated retention values offered to the model. Defaults to 30d,90d,365d. Add forever only for credentials that carry a retention grant.
